_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. config.json is git-ignored.
_N_comment: Default network size used by Step2, Step3, Step4 (single-N scripts)
_networkSizes_comment: List of network sizes to loop over in Step0 batch simulations
_nTrials_comment: Number of training trials per simulation
_trialLen_comment: Duration of each trial in milliseconds
_scale50Flag_comment: If true, stimulus size scales as 50*(N/400); if false, fixed at 50 neurons
_scaleFolder_comment: Data subdirectory name: 'Scaled50' (scaled stimulus) or 'Constant50' (fixed stimulus)
_iterationsPerN_comment: Number of repeat simulations per network size in Step0
_lag_comment: Lag (in trials) for diagonal distance signal in Step3
_trialsSubfolder_comment: Subfolder for longer-run data, e.g. 'Trials1500'. Empty string '' means Data/{scaleFolder}/N{N} directly
_stabilityFrac_comment: Fractional threshold for stabilisation detection. Step04: thr = plateau +/- frac*|initial-plateau|. Step06: thr = plateau + frac*(peak-plateau). Step09: thr = plateau + frac*(peak-plateau). Same parameter ensures fair comparison.
_smoothTrials_comment: Smoothing window in actual trials for stabilisation detection (Step04/06/09). Step06/09 convert to saved-snapshot units internally.
_holdTrials_comment: Number of consecutive trials the criterion must hold (Step04/06/09). Step06/09 convert to saved-snapshot units internally.
